description: A five channel mixer for audio and CV, with a choice of non-linear distortion curves on the mix

params.text: Sets the level of the input with the same number, 0 to 2
Sets the level of the mix leaving the module, 0 to 2

inputs.text: One of the five inputs into the mix, polyphonic

outputs.text: The mix after the output level, with the channel count of whichever input has the most channels, and with no DC blocking applied despite the README calling the mixer AC coupled

notes: no DC blocking filter is applied, so the mix passes slow CV as readily as audio
menu: NLD TYPE — a slider picking the curve the mix is shaped by, its name printed beside it; Linear leaves the mix alone, the rest are tanh and arctan shapes and sampled circuits
